title: Palestinian Suffering Was ‘Never Guiding’ Biden’s Gaza Policy, New Book Says
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
We all know the Biden administration failed in its handling of the genocide in
Gaza, but very few know the full extent of that failure. Author and Washington
Sun correspondent Akbar Shahid Ahmed captures it all in his latest book, _'
Crossing the Red Line: Biden, His Advisors, and Israel's War in Gaza.'_

**" A lot of hardline Democrats want to move past this, pretend Gaza was a
blip," **Ahmed tells **Mehdi**. The DC insider spoke to more than 150
officials for the book, creating a record of just how incapable the Biden
administration was of opposing any of the Israeli government's demands. **" He
[Biden] was aware, to a degree, of Palestinian suffering and Lebanese
suffering… but it was never guiding his policy."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Ahmed also discusses the role that Biden's inner circle played in fueling the
genocide, where officials such as Middle East coordinator Brett McGurk and
National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan both denied starvation in Gaza because
Palestinians **" don't look skinny in the photographs," **according to Ahmed's
reporting.

Watch the full interview to learn what officials told Ahmed, both anonymously
and on the record, and to hear about one Biden official who chose to stop
condemning Russia to continue supporting Israel, a story that Mehdi describes
as **" insane."**
